Subject: Orientation + Skill Lab schedule and async index

Hi Sophie / Acme team —

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday. Moving to the next phase we want to make the first two weeks low-friction: a short orientation, two live skill labs (focused on integration and prompt tuning), and an async index of short walkthroughs you can reference. Proposed plan below: 

- Thu Sep 16, 10:00–11:00 PT — Orientation: account model mapping, environment access, security checklist (recorded)
- Mon Sep 20, 09:00–11:00 PT — Skill Lab #1: Integration workshop (hands-on, bring a sample request)
- Wed Sep 22, 09:00–10:30 PT — Skill Lab #2: Prompt tuning & evals (recorded)
- Async index: 5–8 short videos (5–12 min) + one-pager quickstart + troubleshooting checklist

Attachments: skill-lab-agenda.pdf (detailed times & learning objectives), orientation-quickstart.zip (sample configs & Postman collection).

Requests / asks for you: please confirm 1) which engineers will join live labs, 2) any conflicts with the proposed slots, 3) whether you want private (company-only) recordings or shared links.

I'll coordinate recording delivery and publish the async index to the Drive link below once sessions are done.

Drive folder (incoming): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAcmeOnboarding
HubSpot: HS-23456789

Thanks —
